function.name: reschedule_appointment
function.description: Reschedule an existing appointment for {{organization_display_name}} to a new date and time. Requires the appointment ID, verification phone number, and new appointment details.

appointment_id.description: The unique identifier for the appointment to reschedule

phone.description: The phone number used when booking (for verification)

new_date.description: The new appointment date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., 2024-03-15)

new_time.description: The new appointment time in HH:MM 24-hour format (e.g., 14:30)
